en: Muhammad ibn Umar Fakhr al-Din al-Razi
ar: محمد بن عمر فخر الدين الرازي

description.tr: Tefsîr-i Kebîr'i, Aristocu felsefeyi, İbn Sînâ metafiziğini ve doğa bilimini teolojik tefsire entegre ederek yazılmış en iddialı Kur'an tefsiridir || Râzî, kelâm teolojisi, İbn Sînâ felsefesi ve Yunan biliminin Kur'an hermeneutiği içindeki zirve sentezini temsil eder. || [Tarih notu] Ansiklopedik kapsamına dair ünü 'Esas olanlar hariç her şeyi topladı' sözüne yol açtı.
description.en: His Tafsir al-Kabir is the most intellectually ambitious Quran commentary ever written, integrating Aristotelian philosophy, Avicennan metaphysics, and natural science into theological exegesis || al-Razi represents the peak synthesis of kalam theology, Avicennan philosophy, and Greek science within Quranic hermeneutics. He debated with everyone — and his tafsir is essentially a 32-volume philosophical argument. || [Historiographical note] His reputation for encyclopedic scope led to the saying 'He gathered everything except the essentials' — unfair but revealing of the tension between his ambition and his critics.
description.ar: تفسيره الكبير أكثر تفسير للقرآن طموحاً فكرياً على الإطلاق || يمثل الرازي ذروة التركيب بين الكلام والفلسفة الأفيسينية والعلم اليوناني
